task.pr_title: error: display other error for Display

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
This needs to be different in some way. Either we need to write a full set of handling for each variant, and then call `Display` on the value contained in the `Other(_)` variant, or we need to pick out the `Other(_)` variant and keep calling `Debug` on the catch-all case.

At the moment it unconditionally recurses forever.

evidence.thread_resolution: BiagioFesta: sorry about that, I didn’t look through it carefully (took it a bit lightly since it seemed like a trivial change)
